args.purpose: Calculate average review score for delivered orders arriving more than 30 days after purchase
args.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as delayed_orders_count,
    AVG(r.review_score) as avg_review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date) > 30
